address: 1010 Phet Kasem Road, Huai Chorakhe, Mueang Nakhon Pathom, Nakhon Pathom, 73000, Thailand
bio: A passion for wild ingredients like wild boar, frogs, seafood, and even greens, along with a zeal for local flavours—intense, tangy, and spicy—shapes everything on the menu here. The stir-fried wild boar with chilies and the tom yam soup with snakehead fish are both recommended, as is the seafood cooked according to local recipes. The atmosphere is relaxed and homely, with air-conditioned dining rooms and outdoor seating available....
